text:
To resolve bind-mount permission errors on NAS systems (such as UGOS, Synology, or unRAID), you need to map container file ownership to match your host user permissions.

Set the following environment variables when running your Docker container:

* **`PUID`** and **`PGID`** (or alternatively **`HERMES_UID`** and **`HERMES_GID`**)

Match these variables to the UID and GID of the host user that owns the mounted directory on your NAS. This ensures the container process has the proper read and write access to the bind-mounted configuration files.
